dialogue.Introduction: Oh! A new face. Hello, I am the Zoologist, and I have never met a creature I did not want to hug. Are you an animal person, @?$h#$b#Don't answer yet. Let me see your hands first.$u
dialogue.Mon: Good morning! The chickens woke me up early again. They have very strong opinions about breakfast.$h
dialogue.Tue: The ranch is quiet today. Too quiet. I keep checking the cows to make sure they are still breathing.
dialogue.Wed: Did you know a rabbit can see almost all the way around its head? I find that deeply reassuring for some reason.
dialogue.Thu: I have been reading about owls all week. They can turn their heads nearly all the way around. I am thinking about trying it.$h
dialogue.Fri: Friday means the Stardrop Saloon is full of loud men with worse ideas than usual. I am staying with my bunnies, thank you.
dialogue.Sat: Saturday! I am taking the strays out for a walk along the river. Do you want to come? They are very well behaved, mostly.$h
dialogue.Sun: Sundays are for sleeping in with the barn cats. They do not let me get up before them, so I have given up trying.
dialogue.Mon2: Oh, @, you are back again. Did you bring snacks for the goats? They are not allowed to have snacks, but they know they can ask.
dialogue.Wed2: Every time I see a fox in the forest I want to run over and tell it how pretty its tail is. I have not done it yet. Mostly.
dialogue.Fri2: I was going to say something clever about the Mountain, but I forgot. Ugh. Too many animals in my head today.
dialogue.Mon4: You know, @, I think you are the only one in Pelican Town who listens when I talk about bugs for an hour. That means something to me.$h
dialogue.Tue4: Sometimes I think the Nurse is the only one who understands my ranch smell. She says it gives her a headache. I say it is love.$h
dialogue.Wed4: I grew up in the wild, before any of this. Trees and grass and a very cross mother fox. I miss the quiet, but I like the valley noise too.
dialogue.Thu4: Between you and me, the Merchant tried to sell me a cage that was too small for a squirrel. I told him I would sooner feed him to the chickens.$a
dialogue.Fri4: Have you noticed the Dryad goes very still whenever the flowers bloom? I think she likes my animals. Maybe she is a kind of animal herself.$h
dialogue.Sat4: Coming to the ranch with me is my favorite part of the week. Thanks for keeping me company, @. It is less lonely with you here.$h
dialogue.Sun4: Do you want to hear about my first pet? It was a squirrel named Dumpling. He bit me every single morning and I loved him anyway.$h
dialogue.Mon6: I have been thinking about getting a bird that can talk. Imagine the things it would hear around the Stardrop Saloon.$h
dialogue.Tue6: The Golfer keeps asking me to bring my bunnies to his course. I told him bunnies do not chase golf balls. Well, not on purpose.
dialogue.Thu6: There was a goblin army on the road last week, and my hens hid in the coop for two whole days. I was so proud of them.$h
dialogue.Sat6: I want to tell you a secret. I bottle fireflies at night and let them go before dawn. They are very grateful, I am certain.$h
dialogue.Mon8: @, when the cave bats got into my barn I was terrified. You came running with a torch and calmed everyone down. I do not forget that.$l
dialogue.Tue8: Some nights I wonder if I belong here at all. Then one of my animals curls up in my lap and I remember I am home.$h
dialogue.Wed8: I used to think I had to hide my fox side from people. You have never once made me feel strange for it. Thank you for that, really.$l
dialogue.Thu8: If the valley ever gets too much, I want you to come find me at the ranch. My door is always open and there is always a warm spot by the hay.$h
dialogue.Fri8: The Zoologist is supposed to be brave, you know. But I am scared of the dark, the Eye, and the things under the mines. Being with you helps.$l
dialogue.Sat8: I wrote a little book about every animal on this farm. Your name is in it now, right next to the cats. I hope that is not too strange.$h
dialogue.Sun8: Sleeping next to the barn with you under the stars, after the long festival night, felt like the safest I have been in years. Let us do it again soon.$l
dialogue.Mon10: I have a request, @. When I am gone one day, please look after my animals. I trust you more than anyone to keep them happy.$h
dialogue.Wed10: Forty years ago I would have run from a person like you. Now I cannot imagine the valley without you in it. It feels like being part of a pack.$l
dialogue.Sun10: You are my dearest friend, @. The ranch is yours too, whenever you want it. Every animal here already knows your name.$h
dialogue.summer_Wed: Summer heat makes the chickens lazy and the cows grumpy. I bring them cold water, and they forgive me. Mostly.
dialogue.fall_Fri: The leaves are falling and my foxes are getting fat. I am so proud of them. Do not tell them I said that, they get smug.$h
dialogue.winter_Mon: Winter is hard on the animals, so I keep the barn warm and sing to the goats. They pretend not to like it.$h
dialogue.spring_Sat: Spring! Every baby animal on the ranch is born the same week. I have barely slept, and I would not trade it for anything.$h
dialogue.Sat2: Would you like to see the baby lambs? Be gentle, they are only a day old and they bite a little. Mostly the goats.
dialogue.Sun2: Do not feed the pigs anything with onion in it, @. Trust me, I learned that the hard way and the poor thing was miserable.
dialogue.Tue2: I keep a list of every animal I have met in the valley. It is getting long. I am thinking about adding a whole new section for the monsters.
dialogue.Thu2: The Angler told me the fish in the beach pond are too boring to bother with. Hah! Animals are never boring. Ask me anything.
dialogue.Fri10: Did you know that bunnies can fall in love? I think I might be in love with one of these animals, but my heart belongs to the valley too.$h
dialogue.fall_15: Autumn harvest is coming and the ranch is full of hay. I cannot wait to show you the pumpkins. The biggest one is named Gerald.$h
dialogue.spring_3: Hello! It is an egg morning, and I am sure every egg on this farm is full of surprises. Want to help me count them?$h
dialogue.summer_20: The fireflies are out tonight, @. Let us go catch a few and set them loose together. It is my favorite kind of night.$h
dialogue.winter_10: Bitter cold outside, but the barn is toasty and I have three kittens sleeping on my feet. Come sit with us, I insist.$h

rainy: Rain makes the barn smell wonderful and the animals sleepy. Come hide in the ranch with me and bring me a dry blanket, @.$h

situations.eye: The Eye of Cthulhu is gone, @. Every bunny on the ranch slept with the lights on last night, and so did I. Thank you for that.
situations.evilBoss: Something huge came out of the corruption and it is finally dead. My poor chickens were terrified, but I think they are proud of you now.
situations.skeletron: The Old Man is free from the dungeon! Skeletron is gone, and I can finally walk past that cave without shaking. Thanks, @.$h
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee is dead. I have been wanting honey from her hive for weeks, and now my bees can finally stop being so grumpy.$h
situations.hardmode: The Wall of Flesh fell and the monsters have gotten bigger. My animals are staying inside now. Please be careful out there, @.$u
situations.mechs: One of those metal monsters was destroyed last night. My rabbits thought it was thunder and hid under the hay for hours.
situations.plantera: Plantera is defeated, and the jungle temple is open. The Dryad says the flowers are singing. I am not sure I believe her, but I want to hear it.$h
situations.golem: The Golem is smashed to pieces. I feel bad for it, honestly. Even stone creatures deserve a nice nap somewhere quiet.
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist is gone. The pillars in the sky are glowing and my goats are staring at them all day. I wish they would stop.$u
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord is defeated. The sky looks calmer now, @, and the animals can finally stop barking at the stars.$h
situations.goblins: The goblin army was driven off last night. My hens already got their feathers back in order. Thank you for standing up for the valley.$h
situations.pirates: The pirates were chased off the beach. The Pirate is hiding in his cabin, muttering about his parrot. I think he is fine.
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion is gone and the snow has finally stopped. My foxes are happy to be out again, playing in the drifts.$h
situations.martians: The Martians tried to land near the ranch last night. My cows did not take it well at all. Please never invite them back.$a
situations.bloodMoon: There was a blood moon last night and every animal in the valley howled at once. It was so loud I could not hear myself think.$u
situations.eclipse: The sun went dark yesterday during the eclipse. My chickens went to bed at noon, and I could not blame them one bit.$u
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today! Every animal on the ranch will be wearing a paper hat, including the goats. Please come.$h

festivals.spring13: The Egg Festival! I hid a golden egg in the barn for the animals to find. They are much better at finding eggs than I am, @.$h
festivals.spring24: The Flower Dance! I wore flowers in my hair and the bunnies followed me around the whole evening. It was a very good night.$h
festivals.summer11: The Luau! I brought a bowl of fresh carrot and honey to the community soup. The chickens ate most of it, but I am still proud of it.
festivals.summer28: The Dance of the Moonlight Jellies. Look at them glow on the beach. The fish seem to enjoy dancing, which is a relief for my dignity.$h
festivals.fall16: The Stardew Valley Fair! I entered my fattest pumpkin and my best kitten into the contest. The kitten did not win, but it was very cute about it.
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve! Do not go into the haunted maze alone, @. I heard a ghost growl like a dog in there, and I am not ready to find out what it wants.$u
festivals.winter8: The Festival of Ice! Ice fishing with the Angler is the worst idea I have ever had. He caught a boot, and I caught a cold.$a
festivals.winter25: The Feast of the Winter Star! I got you a bag of birdseed as your gift, @. Do not worry, it is the good kind, the kind that makes birds sing.$h

loved.text: Oh! A real bird? For me? You have made my whole week, @. Look at the little feathers. Hello, sweetie!$l

liked.text: Ooh, cheese for the foxes! They are going to be so spoiled now. Thank you, @.$h

neutral.text: Hm. A little bit of something. I suppose I could feed it to the goats later.

disliked.text: Trash? Please take that back to the trash can, @. My animals do not eat rubbish, and neither do I.$a

hated.text: Are you trying to scare my animals away? Get that boom thing out of here right now!$a

help: Eek! Something is coming! Can someone help me?!
Please, somebody! The hens are screaming in the coop!
Not the bunnies! Someone help me, please!
thanks: Oh, @, you came running! My heart is still pounding.$l
Thank you, @. I thought I would be torn in two, but you held the line.$s
battle: Get back from my hens, you overgrown weasel!
I am cornered, so you had better be sorry!
Do not touch the animals! I bite too, you know!
Stay back! I am a fox at heart, and foxes bite!
courage.hurt: I got knocked flat, and now every hen on the ranch is judging me. Stay home today, @. I need a nap.$s

danger.boss: Something huge is loose, @. Stay close to the barn and keep your voice low. The animals are frightened.$s
danger.invasion: An army is out there and my poor hens are hiding in the coop again. I will hold the barn door, I promise.$s
danger.pumpkinMoon: The Pumpkin Moon is up and I am shaking like a leaf. Please stay with me by the barn, @.$s
danger.frostMoon: The Frost Moon is so cold my tail has gone stiff. I will stay in the barn and keep the animals warm.$h
danger.eclipse: The sun went dark and every animal on the ranch went silent. I am scared, @, but I am not leaving them.$s
danger.bloodMoon: The blood moon has bats swarming everywhere. I will not leave the animals alone, not for anything.$s

events.after: If you see a squirrel with a bow tie, that is Dumpling's cousin. Do not let him steal your lunch.

steps.say: Shh! Don't startle the bunnies, @. They are very sensitive about visitors.$u
Oh, hello again. I am the Zoologist. Well, I was, before I got stuck in this valley with a barn full of critters.#$b#Honestly, I think this one likes you already.$h

steps.question: Would you like to meet my favorite critter?

answers.reply: Oh, this one is named Biscuit. Let him sniff your hand first.$h
Hmph. Your loss. Animals are much nicer than most people.$a

steps.say: Here, hold him gently like this. Good. See? He is already falling asleep.$h
I keep a little notebook of every animal in the valley. You can be in it if you come back to visit.$h

events.after: The chickens still will not let me sleep in, so do not expect me to be very cheerful.

steps.say: Oh, you came back to the ranch! Come in, the goats were just asking about you.$h
I have been thinking about the old days, before the valley. My mother used to say the wild was a place where you only trust what you can feed.#$b#It is strange how many people I trust here now.$h

steps.question: Do you ever miss a place you used to live?

answers.reply: Then we understand each other a little, @. It helps to say it out loud sometimes.$h
Lucky you. My old home was full of thorns and ghosts.$s

steps.say: The Nurse says I should stop talking to the animals and talk to people more. I told her the animals listen better.$h
Anyway, thank you for listening. It is nice to have someone who does not just stare at my freckles.$h

events.after: The Dryad told me the trees here whisper when you pass. I think she is making that up, but I still checked.

steps.say: Oh, @! I came out here to find a nest of baby birds, and look who found me instead.$h
This is the Dryad. She looks after the forest, so I always ask her before I touch anything.
Hello, child of the sun. The forest is glad you visit. Respect the seedlings and they will respect you.$h
The Zoologist knows her animals better than most. I would trust her with a sapling.$h
Look there, under that log. A tiny fox kit, sleeping like a little loaf.$u
Do not wake it up, @. If we are quiet, its mother will come back for it. Nature is the best teacher.$h

events.after: Sleep well tonight, @. The fireflies will keep you company on the way home.$h

steps.say: @, you came out here in the dark just to see me? I was sitting by the fence, counting the stars with the cows.$l
When I was small, I was always scared of the night. The wild is loud in the dark, and I never knew which sound was a friend.#$b#Now the night sounds like home to me.$h

steps.question: Do you still feel scared sometimes?

answers.reply: Ha! Me too, a little. Let us keep each other company against the ghosts.$h
@... that is the sweetest thing anyone has said to me this year.$l

steps.say: Look, a firefly just landed on your sleeve. They like you as much as I do.$h
I would like to keep you close, @. Not like a pet, of course. Like a friend who never leaves the barn.$l
Goodnight, my friend. Come by the ranch any time you need a warm spot.$h

events.after: Please tell the animals I said goodnight. They will want to hear it from you.

steps.say: @, come in quietly. The whole barn is asleep, and I have something I want to give you.$l
This is my old bug net. I used it every summer when I was a girl, chasing butterflies over the cliffs.#$b#I want you to have it. You have caught plenty of things I cannot.$h

steps.question: Will you keep the ranch safe for me, always?

answers.reply: Then my heart is yours to keep, @, and the animals will never be lonely again.$l
Trying is good enough for me. I love you for it anyway.$h

steps.say: You are the first person to make the valley feel like a family, not just a town.$h
So come to the ranch whenever you like. Bring nothing but yourself, and I will bring the cats.$h
